summary: Busy Musgrave Road bus lane beside shopping centre; no parking, flats opposite.

best_section.where: Musgrave Road east kerb beside Indooroopilly Shopping Centre

drivers.seclusion: Shopping centre one side, apartment blocks 18 m across the road; very exposed.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a bus lane with buses queued; no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with buses and heavy traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the kerb; no parking convention.

sun_shade: Open to sun; shopping centre building to the east gives morning shade.
